spectators.label: Dojo student with a red headband
spectators.look: lean teenage boy with short spiky black hair, thick determined eyebrows and a scraped nose, wearing a plain white karate gi with frayed sleeves, a white belt and a bright red headband whose long tails trail behind his head
spectators.idle: fists clenched at his sides, studying the fighters with intense focus
spectators.cheer: punching the air with one fist, shouting a kiai
spectators.shocked: headband tails flying up, mouth wide open, eyes like dinner plates

spectators.label: Kung-fu master in crimson silk
spectators.look: wiry middle-aged man with black hair in a tight topknot bun, calm narrow eyes and a long thin drooping black mustache, wearing a crimson silk mandarin-collar jacket with gold knot buttons, wide black trousers and black cloth slippers
spectators.idle: hands clasped behind his back, nodding approvingly
spectators.cheer: one hand raised high in a crane-beak kung-fu pose, shouting
spectators.shocked: mustache tips flicked straight up, eyebrows shot high

spectators.label: Heavyweight wrestler in a yukata
spectators.look: enormous round heavyweight wrestler with oiled black hair in a small topknot, a round friendly face with tiny eyes and a huge belly, wearing a dark-blue cotton yukata loosely open at the chest, a thick white rope belt and wooden geta sandals
spectators.idle: arms folded over his big belly, calmly watching
spectators.cheer: both arms spread wide out to the sides, booming belly laugh
spectators.shocked: palms slapped to his puffed cheeks, eyes popping

spectators.label: Masked pro wrestler
spectators.look: muscular pro wrestler with a bodybuilder physique and a full-head wrestling mask in royal blue with silver flame patterns around the eye holes, wearing a sleeveless blue singlet, a silver championship belt with a round blank gold plate, white knee pads and tall blue boots
spectators.idle: flexing one bicep and admiring it
spectators.cheer: double-bicep pose with arms out to the sides, shouting through the mask
spectators.shocked: both hands gripping the sides of his mask, leaning back

spectators.label: Boxer in a satin robe
spectators.look: athletic young boxer with a short brown buzz cut, a taped nose and a swollen eyebrow, wearing a shiny red satin boxing robe open over a white tank top, red boxing gloves and a white towel draped around his neck
spectators.idle: bouncing lightly, throwing small jabs at the air
spectators.cheer: both gloves punching straight up, roaring
spectators.shocked: gloves pressed up against his cheeks, eyes huge

spectators.label: Karate girl with a high ponytail
spectators.look: fierce teenage girl with a high black ponytail, a white headband and sharp confident eyes, wearing a crisp white karate gi with a black belt and white tape wrapped around her wrists
spectators.idle: arms crossed, smug little grin
spectators.cheer: jumping fist pump with a sharp kiai shout
spectators.shocked: hands clapped over her mouth, ponytail flicked straight up

spectators.label: Bo-staff fighter with green hair
spectators.look: lanky young man with messy green-dyed hair, freckles and a cocky grin, wearing a sleeveless dark-green tunic with a yellow sash, brown wrapped shins and bandaged forearms, carrying a long red-lacquered wooden bo staff
spectators.idle: staff laid across his shoulders with both wrists draped over it
spectators.cheer: staff thrust diagonally up in one hand, whooping
spectators.shocked: staff slipping from his hands, jaw dropped

spectators.label: Taekwondo athlete
spectators.look: slim athletic young woman with a short chestnut bob and bright eager eyes, wearing a white V-neck taekwondo uniform with black collar trim, a blue belt and white foot pads
spectators.idle: standing on one foot with the other knee raised in a stretch
spectators.cheer: jumping with both fists up, cheering loudly
spectators.shocked: both hands on top of her head, eyes wide

spectators.label: Muay Thai fighter
spectators.look: lean dark-skinned fighter with a short black crew cut and a hard stare, wearing a white-and-red braided headband ring, red cord armbands on both biceps, a red-and-gold satin fight jacket over red shorts, and white tape on his hands and ankles
spectators.idle: rolling his shoulders, chin tucked, eyes on the ring
spectators.cheer: elbow pumped up into the air, shouting
spectators.shocked: taped hands gripping his headband, mouth open

spectators.label: Judo heavyweight
spectators.look: broad square-jawed judoka with a flat-top black haircut, cauliflower ears and a serious frown, wearing a thick royal-blue judo gi with the sleeves rolled up and a brown belt
spectators.idle: thumbs hooked into his belt, frowning seriously
spectators.cheer: arms thrown out wide to the sides, roaring
spectators.shocked: gripping his own lapels, jaw dropped

spectators.label: Tiny dojo kid
spectators.look: small round-cheeked boy of about six with a black bowl cut and a gap-toothed grin, wearing an oversized white gi whose sleeves cover his hands and a yellow belt tied in a huge bow
spectators.idle: copying a fighting stance with tiny fists
spectators.cheer: hopping up and down with both arms up
spectators.shocked: hands on his cheeks, eyes huge and sparkling

spectators.label: Wing chun woman
spectators.look: composed woman with long black hair in a single thick braid, a beauty mark under one eye and a calm smile, wearing a sky-blue kung-fu jacket with white cuffs and knot buttons, loose white trousers and black slippers
spectators.idle: one palm raised in a calm guard, the other at her chest
spectators.cheer: clapping above her head, laughing
spectators.shocked: braid whipping sideways, mouth open in surprise

spectators.label: Capoeira player with a berimbau
spectators.look: lean dark-skinned young man with short twists tied on top, a bright wide grin, a white sleeveless top, white loose capoeira trousers with a green-and-yellow cord belt, barefoot, carrying a berimbau musical bow with a gourd over his shoulder
spectators.idle: swaying side to side to a rhythm
spectators.cheer: berimbau lifted high in one hand, other arm up, singing
spectators.shocked: crouching low with one hand on his head, eyes wide

spectators.label: Scarred street brawler
spectators.look: hulking bald brawler with a scar across one eye and a thick black beard, wearing a torn sleeveless brown leather vest, spiked black wristbands, ripped grey pants and a heavy chain belt
spectators.idle: cracking his knuckles and glaring
spectators.cheer: arms spread out wide to the sides, bellowing
spectators.shocked: one eyebrow shot up, jaw dropped, beard bristling

spectators.label: Kendo practitioner
spectators.look: serious young man with neat dark hair tied low, wearing a dark-indigo kendo jacket and pleated hakama with a black lacquered chest guard, holding his barred face helmet under one arm and a bamboo practice sword in the other hand
spectators.idle: helmet tucked under his arm, bamboo sword tip planted at his feet
spectators.cheer: bamboo sword raised high overhead, shouting
spectators.shocked: helmet clutched to his chest, eyes wide

spectators.label: Retired champion with medals
spectators.look: burly middle-aged man with a greying flat-top, thick sideburns and a crooked nose, broad shoulders gone a little soft, wearing a green tracksuit jacket over a white tee with three gold medals on red ribbons around his neck
spectators.idle: arms crossed, critiquing the footwork with a smirk
spectators.cheer: arms out to the sides, shaking both fists
spectators.shocked: medals swinging, one hand pressed over his heart

spectators.label: Sporty brawler with pink buns
spectators.look: toned young woman with pink-dyed hair in two small buns, a bandage on her cheek and a confident smirk, wearing a black sports top under an open yellow track jacket, black bike shorts, red fingerless gloves and white sneakers
spectators.idle: hand on her hip, blowing a pink gum bubble
spectators.cheer: double fist pump, shouting
spectators.shocked: popped gum stuck across her face, eyes wide

spectators.label: Steppe wrestler in a deel
spectators.look: tall broad wrestler with a round ruddy face and a drooping black mustache, wearing a pointed fur-trimmed hat, an embroidered blue knee-length deel robe with an orange sash, and upturned brown leather boots
spectators.idle: hands on his hips, chest puffed out
spectators.cheer: arms spread wide to the sides, flapping like a soaring eagle
spectators.shocked: hat knocked askew, mouth hanging open

spectators.label: Nunchaku fan in a red jumpsuit
spectators.look: skinny young man with spiky orange hair and dark sunglasses pushed up on his forehead, wearing a red track jumpsuit with white side stripes and white sneakers, holding a pair of wooden nunchaku
spectators.idle: nunchaku tucked under his armpit, grinning
spectators.cheer: spinning the nunchaku over his head, whooping
spectators.shocked: nunchaku dangling limp, sunglasses fallen onto his nose

spectators.label: Stern karate sensei
spectators.look: stern middle-aged karate master with a short black beard streaked grey and heavy eyebrows, wearing a faded black gi, a worn black belt and a white headband, carrying a plank of pine wood for breaking under one arm
spectators.idle: arms folded, the wooden plank pinned against his side
spectators.cheer: plank held out to the side in one hand, other fist out, shouting
spectators.shocked: plank snapped in two in his hands, eyes bulging
